name: Fishnet Struts and Happy Trails
summary: FOUR ADOPTED — Orianna, Felicity, Riven and Heather. Another camping trip. AND BRYN GETS TIRED OF RENTING THE AQUATIC CENTRE'S POOL, so the family builds its own — pool, pool house, poilside bar — and Torie corrupts the shape of it.
events: ADOPTED: ORIANNA, a gothic stripper, introduced by Destiny in Arc 14 · FELICITY, Orianna's maid wife · RIVEN, a bratty librarian · HEATHER, Riven's gym-bunny slut wife

BRYN IS DONE RENTING THE AQUATIC CENTRE'S POOL. She hires excavators — RAGNAR PULLED A FEW STRINGS, again — and the girls build THE POOL, THE POOL HOUSE AND THE POOLSIDE BAR themselves, the way they built everything else
AND TORIE CORRUPTS IT INTO THE SHAPE OF BRYN'S ABS. The fourth body on this land is a swimming pool, and it is her wife's stomach
More happens in this arc; the Archive holds this much
